name: Tabber
description: zen-style ctrl+tab: switch tabs in recently used order, with an on-screen list. works together with the karabiner rule.

mru-next.description: previous tab (karabiner sends this on ctrl+tab)

mru-prev.description: move back up the list (karabiner sends this on ctrl+shift+tab)

mru-commit.description: confirm (karabiner sends this when ctrl is released)
